text: The assessment is part of broader frameworks such as the MAPDRR 2017–2030, which sets targets for hazard risk reduction, and the NDC 2021, which aligns with the Paris Agreement. It also involves the Sendai Framework for Disaster Risk Reduction and ASEAN's AADMER Work Programme. Key public actors include the Department of Meteorology and Hydrology and the Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock and Irrigation, while international partners like UNDP and FAO support climate resilience and drought-resilient agriculture.
